evidence_snippets: The toolbar in the Query pane displays the resources searched for log entries: Project logs and Default : Log entries that originate in the selected project, folder, or organization are returned.
If resources in multiple projects or regions are searched for log entries, then the Observability Analytics might show different log entries than the Logs Explorer page.
Select which resources are searched for log entries This section describes how to view or change which resources are searched for log entries.
